vetSays.line: 🛡️ Caroline, Finn, Norbert and Aki met them at the door — 4 put down. Caroline, Finn, Norbert, Aki are hurt.

📺 "Oh, you survived the AUDIENCE NOTES? Cute. We've stopped pretending these are animals now. That was the FINAL DRAFT, folks — what comes out of the treeline next was never alive the way you mean it."
🛡️ Caroline, Finn, Norbert, Palesa and Aki met them at the door — 5 put down. Caroline, Finn, Norbert, Palesa, Aki are hurt.
SYSTEM: "That was... a lot. The producers say the ratings were historic. I don’t know what to do with that sentence."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Greta just put down The Redactor... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Caroline just put down Ad Break... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
🛡️ Caroline, Norbert, Greta and Xavier met them at the door — 3 put down, 1 barely walked away. Norbert, Greta, Xavier are hurt.
Xavier keeps coming back to Caroline’s tale of Ad Break — and now has a beast to hunt.
Aki keeps coming back to Caroline’s tale of Ugly-Eyes — and now has a beast to hunt.
Theo keeps coming back to Caroline’s tale of Ugly-Eyes — and now has a beast to hunt.
🛡️ Norbert and Greta met them at the door — 1 put down, 1 barely walked away. Norbert, Greta are hurt.
📺 "We've been watching you for a LONG time. Your faiths. Your formats. Your little institutions. So we built something out of... well. Out of YOU. Say hello to the MIRROR DRAFT."

◈ SYSTEM: "Four waves. FOUR. The producers are — okay, I'm saying it: FINALES need a NATION. You've got a region; now make it a REALM. Bind fires under one head, or bend the knee to someone who has. The higher-ups are watching. ...Did I say higher-ups? I said NOTHING. Forget the higher-ups."

◈ ARC IV — THE INEFFICIENCY. SYSTEM: "ROUNDING ERROR RECLASSIFIED: ANOMALY. Organic consumption yields impossible output. Recalculating. Recalculating." — They finally see it. The thing they laughed at — needing to EAT — is the engine. Their confusion is your weapon now. You stood up to the calibration fauna, the audience's notes, the Final Draft — lived through their Show, weathered the worst together, and built something bigger than a village. One day humanity will need a case to make. The case is made of deeds, not words — and yours, though unfinished, are undeniable. (Feasted buffs burn ho
📺 "But finales — FINALES need a LEGEND, sweetheart. More STANDING — blood, bonds, or bread — and look the Mirror Draft in the eye. The producers are WAITING."
★ IDENTIFIED: European Elder. Elder. Big shrub; flat white flower plates in June, drooping black berry clusters in late summer. Uses unknown — harvest, taste, and learn.
📚 Village knowledge: Nikolai taught everyone about European Elder. The Codex grows without you lifting a finger.
Nikolai passes European Elder around the fire — calling it "Wild Ramps" like they've always known. The others nod along, and just like that the wrong name is loose in the village.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Botros just put down The Herald... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
Sari keeps coming back to Botros’s tale of Loud-Eyes — and now has a beast to hunt.
⚠ This one is different — scarred, braced, waiting for your opening. A Scarred veteran.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sari just put down The Suburb... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."
📻 The producers name it: the Nielsen. Ratings embodied. It fights boring — and the crowd adores it for that.
📺 SYSTEM: "Oh — OH. Everybody saw that, right? Sari just put down Big Big... on CAMERA. That's a veteran kill, folks. REMEMBER the name."

⚠ This one is different — bigger, and it didn't come alone. A Pack-leader veteran.

⚠️ 1 threats: Pack-leader Ugly-Eyes (×2) — all here, all now.
Your party: just you. You are outnumbered — fight like it.

killerTaleLog: [day 44] Norbert: The fire settles. Norbert has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sunbasker — I put it down today." "Its scales go from dull brown to molten gold. Heat shimmers off its back. It's ready." "It goes still in the sun. Gold spreads across its back — the charge is building." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Caroline says "The fire feels smaller now." Greta asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 44] Norbert: The fire settles. Norbert has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Chorus Line — I put it down today." "The music starts — an actual audio cue, 4/4, and you can feel the downbeat coming. The downbeat is the kick. Deafness breaks the telegraph but not the beat." "The count stutters — ONE-two-THREE-and— the kick comes on the off-beat, where your dancing feet aren’t." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Aki says "So it bleeds." Greta mutters "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 44] Palesa: The fire settles. Palesa has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nevermore — I put it down today." "Its shadow detaches from the branch-shadow and slides across the ground toward you — a straight black lane, growing. The bird hasn't moved. The shadow has." "It climbs, laughing in a dead voice — out of spear reach, watching." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Aki mutters "And you're still standing." Rafael mutters "Did it look at you? Before?" Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 44] Theo: The fire settles. Theo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Hummice — I put it down today." "A low hum rises from the grass. It harmonizes with itself. Your teeth ache." "Teeth in the grass, everywhere at once — a tide of small bites." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Xavier breathes "We've been walking past those." Caroline says quietly "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 45] Aki: The fire settles. Aki has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Mosquito — I put it down today." "Whining, closing. It circles — the sound gets closer." "The whine steadies — DIVE. Telegraphed." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Palesa asks "Did it look at you? Before?" Theo breathes "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 45] Palesa: The fire settles. Palesa has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Extended Warranty — I put it down today." "RING. RING. The sound is inside your skull. 'We have been trying to REACH you about your—'" "It dials faster. More voices. All of them want to talk about your coverage." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Xavier says "The fire feels smaller now." Theo breathes "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 47] Palesa: The fire settles. Palesa has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Sweeps Week — I put it down today." "The grass stops moving the way wind moves it. Two amber eyes — then the whole striped avalanche." "It circles, unhurried. It has seen this episode before — and it knows how it ends." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Rafael says "Did it look at you? Before?" Aki breathes "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 49] Palesa: The fire settles. Palesa has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Focus Group — I put it down today." "The murmur rises — you can HEAR them deliberating. They're about to love your dodge and hate your strike. The ratings are honest and visible." "The lead mouth-head clears its throat — the opening question, focus-grouped and focus-grouped again: ‘So... how does that make you FEEL?’" A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Norbert asks "The fire feels smaller now." Theo asks "So it bleeds." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 49] Palesa: The fire settles. Palesa has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Terms of Service — I put it down today." "The text on the scroll GLOWS before a clause activates — the glow runs along the words like a fuse. The telegraph is literally legible. Reading is the defense." "A new paragraph slides in at the bottom — §12.4, freshly inked. You definitely didn’t agree to this. You also definitely did." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Greta mutters "So it bleeds." Rafael says "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 59] Rafael: The fire settles. Rafael has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Nightlight — I put it down today." "A soft green glow under the water. Pretty. That's the problem — it's pretty." "The whiskers go rigid — then lash." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Xavier breathes "We've been walking past those." Palesa says "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 61] Aki: The fire settles. Aki has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Rut King — I put it down today." "He lowers the crown. Paws the earth once, twice. The whole forest holds its breath." "His chest swells. The inhale goes on too long — cover your ears or get behind something." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Palesa says quietly "Say that again — slower." Theo says quietly "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 69] Thabo: The fire settles. Thabo has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Spool — I put it down today." "RECORD first — harmless, it watches. Then REPLAY: the reels on its back spin, and the spinning reel SHOWS what's loaded. Watch the reel, not the tape." "RECORD. The reels turn slowly, drinking in everything you do. It is learning the shape of your turns." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Petra says "And you're still standing." Norbert breathes "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 72] Norbert: The fire settles. Norbert has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Choir Toad — I put it down today." "Its throat swells. The air goes thick. Every frog for a mile answers at once." "It crouches — clumsy, obvious, and faster than it looks." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Petra asks "We've been walking past those." Greta breathes "Say that again — slower." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 73] Zoe: The fire settles. Zoe has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "The Callback — I put it down today." "It speaks — in their voice, saying things they said. The face is too symmetrical. The eyes don't track. The wrongness is the telegraph." "It studies you — tilting their head the way they tilted theirs. It is getting better at being them." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Nikolai mutters "And you're still standing." Botros mutters "We've been walking past those." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 74] Palesa: The fire settles. Palesa has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Buffering — I put it down today." "Its telegraphs describe the FUTURE — 'it will step left.' Afterimages trail it; the faintest frame is the real present. You must pre-dodge — or stop predicting entirely." "It stutters backward — three seconds ago it was THERE. The afterimages collapse into one frame." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Petra mutters "And you're still standing." Rafael mutters "And you're still standing." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"

[day 74] Palesa: The fire settles. Palesa has been quiet all evening, and now everyone knows why. "Flashbulb Moth — I put it down today." "It lands. It folds its wings. The light in the clearing changes, like someone adjusting a lamp." "It lets go of the air and simply... drifts. Somewhere else. Hard to predict." A beat of silence, then the questions come all at once. Rafael says "The fire feels smaller now." Zoe says quietly "Tell me you didn't go alone." Someone at the edge of the light says what everyone's thinking: "So — what are we calling it?"
